name: objective_shock_single_signal_discovery

pressure_support_domain.sustained_hypotension: two consecutive hourly routine-cuff bins with SBP <90 or direct MAP <65
pressure_support_domain.continuous_support: positive-rate actual administration of frozen seven-drug vasoactive/inotropic set
pressure_support_domain.mcs: validated IABP, Impella, or ECMO initiation

hypoperfusion_domain.lactate: post-landmark >=4 or >=2 with >=0.5 mmol/L rise from latest valid pre-anchor lactate
hypoperfusion_domain.urine_output: <30 mL/h across fully post-anchor rolling 6h with >=4 documented hourly bins
hypoperfusion_domain.creatinine: >=0.3 mg/dL or >=1.5-fold rise from latest pre-anchor creatinine
hypoperfusion_domain.alt: >200 U/L when baseline <=200, or >=3-fold rise from baseline

primary_model: modified Poisson log link with HC0 robust variance
multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg separately across 36 primary and 36 lead-sensitivity tests

anti_circularity.urine_candidates: exclude urine output as hypoperfusion-domain completion

selection: lower primary q, then larger absolute log RR, then higher coverage; one provisional winner only
novelty: review only the top statistical winner; established marker ends study without runner-up
eicu_rule: no candidate association access before one winner and external protocol/code freeze
